pages.text: The extractor's first pulse travels farther than its light. Things in the dark hear it.
pages.title: Hold the line
The machine draws breath
pages.text: A defense objective raises a device beside its checkpoint. Protect it until the countdown finishes. Waves focus the machine; waiting at the next marker will not protect it.

pages.title: The machine draws breath
pages.text: Its remaining integrity matters. Player blows can damage it too.

pages.title: Make a place to stand
pages.text: Scout the approach before activation. Clear room to move, keep a way back to the device, and bring the equipment you need to interrupt attackers.

pages.title: Make a place to stand
pages.text: If a required device is destroyed, the expedition fails. An optional device can be lost without ending the route, but its bonus is gone.

pages.title: Make a place to stand
pages.text: A vanished device is treated as destroyed. The terminal never assumes an absent machine survived.
